chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd also narrated this hadith from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀṣim:

key_terms.أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ: a transmitter in the chain of narration
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ: one of the transmitters in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ: the final named transmitter in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: meaning a report with the same wording or meaning as the previous one

ai.seo_question: What does “مِثْلَهُ” mean in a hadith chain in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This report indicates that the same hadith was transmitted through another sanad/isnad. It serves as a parallel transmission supporting the previously cited narration in the chapter on tayammum.
